experience.org: National Informatics Centre · Government of India · New Delhi
bullets: Expanded the initial project scope to 10+ enterprise dashboards for the NIC Parichay Portal.
Built 5+ distinct reusable UI components (charts, tables and more), standardizing cross-application design layouts through collaborative team presentations.
Integrated REST APIs and real-time data visualizations with Axios and MUI-X Charts, enhancing dashboard interactivity across 15+ data points.

ride.label: OFF THE CLOCK
ride.title: Fuel, focus & full throttle.
paragraphs: Every engineer needs a reset button. Mine has two wheels. Sundays are for early starts, empty highways, and my Triumph Speed T4 rumbling past Amer Fort before the city wakes up.
Riding taught me what shipping software keeps confirming: smooth is fast, preparation beats panic, and the way through a sharp corner is to look where you want to go.
